scientific_integrity: Exact Hilbert-space theorem proved for all positive integer degrees and power horizons. Coefficient formulas follow from normalized disk moments; strict log convexity controls all crossing paths. Finite exact checks are supplementary, not substitutes for the proof.
scientific_limitations: Only unweighted harmonic Bergman analytic monomial Toeplitz operators.
No claim about full resolvent norms or arbitrary polynomial symbols.
Publication priority remains subject to independent literature review, especially older weighted-shift literature.
title: Exact inverse-power amplification and norming modes of harmonic Bergman monomial Toeplitz operators
